rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, but it submitted a return without first confirming the item and refund method, violating the requirement to confirm any order-changing action. The user’s initial request was to return the less expensive tablet with a refund to credit card; unless the agent asked for confirmation (which it did not), it should not have switched to returning the more expensive item with refund to gift card. The agent proceeded to return a specific tablet (item_id 6065192424 from order #W9571698) and issued a refund to a gift card without user confirmation and contrary to the initial stated preference. Final information was presented as completed without prior confirmation. Therefore, the interaction fails the policy compliance bar.
